title: Outlook mobile: Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events on iOS and Android
summary: Hold: the mailbox-scope and simulation control links to instructions for non-Microsoft app policies, which cannot include Exchange or run in simulation mode. The roadmap facts match the record, but the licensing field also understates published product-level entitlements and the policy-tip path needs its intervening configuration steps.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Purview DLP support for calendar events in Outlook mobile.
claims.quote: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events.

claims.fix: After the existing quotation add: 'The support matrix at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-policy-tips-reference instead describes Outlook Mobile conditions and actions as a subset, and sensitive information types as varying by version and license.' Cite that matrix; retain the quotation as the mobile reference's statement.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; controls[1].governs and note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The cited non-Microsoft connected-app instructions document the UI control for a DLP policy's mailbox scope and simulation or enforcement.
claims.quote: Non-Microsoft app locations can be selected together, but they can't be combined with other locations like SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Fabric, or Devices in the same policy. ... Simulation mode isn't supported for non-Microsoft connected app policies.
claims.fix: Keep the printed entry path 'Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy', which is documented, but replace controls[1].ui.docs and its table link with https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-cc-email and cite that page. Replace the row note with: 'Starts policy creation; select Exchange email for the location and choose the policy mode later in the wizard. The cmdlet runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell; -ExchangeLocation accepts only All. Calendar-specific behavior is not yet documented.' The replacement reference documents Exchange email and Run the policy in simulation mode.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <policy name> -ExchangeLocation All -Mode <PolicyMode> creates a DLP policy with Exchange email included and the specified policy mode.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies ... The valid value for this parameter is All. ... The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the DLP policy. ... The Name parameter specifies the unique name of the DLP policy.

claims.claim: The currently cited UI page describes non-Microsoft connected-app policies in preview.
claims.quote: Use Microsoft Purview data loss prevention policies for non-Microsoft connected apps (preview) ... This feature is currently in preview.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The DLP cmdlet's policy modes are Enable, Disable, TestWithNotifications and TestWithoutNotifications, with the two Test modes providing simulation.
claims.quote: Valid values are: ... Enable ... Disable ... TestWithNotifications: Simulation mode where no actions are taken, but notifications are sent. ... TestWithoutNotifications: Simulation mode where no actions are taken, and no notifications are sent.
